classes.name: logic_auto
classes.description: Logic auto: fires outputs on map spawn, new game, load game, or background map load.

outputs.name: OnMapSpawn
outputs.description: Fired when the map spawns.

outputs.name: OnNewGame
outputs.description: Fired on a new game.

outputs.name: OnLoadGame
outputs.description: Fired when a save is loaded.

outputs.name: OnBackgroundMap
outputs.description: Fired when the map loads as a background map.

outputs.name: OnMultiNewMap
outputs.description: Fired on a multiplayer new map.

outputs.name: OnMultiNewRound
outputs.description: Fired on a multiplayer new round.

classes.name: logic_relay
classes.description: Logic relay: fires its OnTrigger output when triggered. Used to chain logic together.

outputs.name: OnTrigger
outputs.description: Fired when the relay is triggered.

outputs.name: OnSpawn
outputs.description: Fired when the relay spawns.

classes.name: logic_timer
classes.description: Logic timer: fires OnTimer repeatedly at a set interval.

keyvalues.name: UseRandomTime
keyvalues.description: Use a random interval between LowerRandomBound and UpperRandomBound. 0 = off, 1 = on.

outputs.name: OnTimer
outputs.description: Fired every interval.

outputs.name: OnTimerHigh
outputs.description: Fired when the timer goes high.

outputs.name: OnTimerLow
outputs.description: Fired when the timer goes low.

classes.name: logic_branch
classes.description: Logic branch: stores a boolean; fires OnTrue or OnFalse when tested.

inputs.name: SetValueTest
inputs.description: Set the value and test it.

inputs.name: ToggleTest
inputs.description: Toggle the value and test it.

outputs.name: OnTrue
outputs.description: Fired when the value tests true.

outputs.name: OnFalse
outputs.description: Fired when the value tests false.

inputs.name: InValue

inputs.name: PickRandomShuffle

outputs.name: OnCase01

outputs.name: OnCase05
outputs.description: Fired when the input value matches Case05.

outputs.name: OnCase06
outputs.description: Fired when the input value matches Case06.

outputs.name: OnCase07
outputs.description: Fired when the input value matches Case07.

outputs.name: OnCase08
outputs.description: Fired when the input value matches Case08.

outputs.name: OnCase11

outputs.description: Fired when the input value matches Case13.

classes.name: math_counter
classes.description: Math counter: stores a number; fires OnHitMax and OnHitMin at its limits. Two Add inputs with max 2 model an AND-gate: it fires OnHitMax only after both inputs arrive.

keyvalues.name: min
keyvalues.description: Minimum value; reaching it fires OnHitMin.

keyvalues.name: max
keyvalues.description: Maximum value; reaching it fires OnHitMax.

inputs.name: Add
inputs.description: Add a value to the counter.

inputs.name: Subtract
inputs.description: Subtract a value from the counter.

inputs.name: Divide
inputs.description: Divide the counter by a value.

inputs.name: Multiply
inputs.description: Multiply the counter by a value.

inputs.name: SetValueNoFire
inputs.description: Set the counter value without firing outputs.

inputs.name: GetValue
inputs.description: Fire OutValue with the current value.

outputs.name: OnHitMax
outputs.description: Fired when the counter reaches its maximum.

outputs.name: OnHitMin
outputs.description: Fired when the counter reaches its minimum.

outputs.name: OnChangedFromMin
outputs.description: Fired when the counter leaves its minimum.

outputs.name: OnChangedFromMax
outputs.description: Fired when the counter leaves its maximum.

outputs.name: OutValue
outputs.description: Fired with the current value.

classes.name: logic_compare
classes.description: Logic compare: compares a value against CompareValue and fires the matching output.

inputs.name: SetCompareValue
inputs.description: Set the value to compare against.

inputs.name: Compare
inputs.description: Compare the values and fire the matching output.

inputs.name: SetValueNoFire
inputs.description: Set the value without firing outputs.

outputs.name: OnEqualTo
outputs.description: Fired when the value equals CompareValue.

outputs.name: OnNotEqualTo
outputs.description: Fired when the value does not equal CompareValue.

outputs.name: OnGreaterThan
outputs.description: Fired when the value is greater than CompareValue.

outputs.name: OnLessThan
outputs.description: Fired when the value is less than CompareValue.

classes.name: env_global
classes.description: Env global: controls a global state flag shared across maps.

keyvalues.name: GlobalState
keyvalues.description: Name of the global state flag.

classes.name: point_template
classes.description: Point template: spawns copies of up to 16 template entities.

inputs.name: ForceSpawnAtEntityOrigin
inputs.description: Spawn the template entities at this entity's origin.
